name: com.nexengineworks.nexui.studio
description:
Visual authoring extension package for NexUI. Provides Unity Editor tools for editing NexUI screens, bindings, motions, themes, policies, and validation.

REQUIRED BEFORE IMPORT: UniTask 2.5.10 or newer (com.cysharp.unitask), then the NexUI runtime package. See the NexUI package description for UniTask installation.

samples.description: Sample screens and metadata for NexUI Designer.
